# Bundled Latin Fonts

Source Sans 3 and Source Code Pro are copied unchanged from the published npm
packages `@fontsource-variable/source-sans-3@5.3.1` and
`@fontsource-variable/source-code-pro@5.3.1`. Only their Latin and Latin Extended
variable-weight WOFF2 subsets, normal and italic, are included. These eight files
total 288,988 bytes. The matching SIL Open Font License 1.1 texts are included as
`LICENSE-source-sans-3.txt` and `LICENSE-source-code-pro.txt`.

The binaries and license texts were verified byte for byte against those npm
release archives on 2026-11-15. The CSS unicode ranges keep Chinese text on the
configured system fallbacks. Greek, Cyrillic, and other additional subsets are
not bundled; add the relevant licensed subsets if a publication needs them.
